domains.description: List of domains with their ACME configuration. Each item defines a domain and its renewal parameters. Required fields: name, challenge_method. Other fields are optional depending on challenge method or advanced use cases.

config_home.description: Directory to store acme.sh configuration files. Corresponds to --config-home.

cert_home.description: Directory to store issued certificates. Corresponds to --cert-home.

accountconf.description: Path to custom account configuration file. Corresponds to --accountconf.

home.description: acme.sh installation home directory. Corresponds to --home.

domains[].webroot.description: Webroot directory for HTTP validation (required if challenge_method is 'http').

domains[].dns_manual.description: Use DNS manual mode (requires --yes-I-know-dns-manual-mode-enough-go-ahead-please). Only one of dns_manual or dns_hook should be set.

domains[].dns_hook.description: DNS hook name (e.g., 'dns_cf') for automatic DNS API support. Only one of dns_manual or dns_hook should be set.

domains[].keylength.description: Domain key length. Valid values: 2048, 3072, 4096, 8192, ec-256, ec-384, ec-521. Corresponds to -k.

domains[].pre_hook.description: Command to run before certificate operations. Corresponds to --pre-hook.

domains[].post_hook.description: Command to run after certificate operations (success or failure). Corresponds to --post-hook.

domains[].renew_hook.description: Command to run only on successful renewals. Corresponds to --renew-hook.

domains[].deploy_hook.description: Deploy hook name to run after successful issuance/renewal. Corresponds to --deploy-hook.

domains[].account_email.description: Account email address. Required for initial registration. Corresponds to --email.

domains[].revoke_reason.description: Revocation reason code (0-10). Only set if revoking. Corresponds to --revoke-reason.

domains[].notify_hook.description: Custom notification hook name. Corresponds to --notify-hook.

domains[].cert_file.description: Path to copy the leaf certificate after issuance/renewal. Corresponds to --cert-file.

domains[].key_file.description: Path to copy the private key after issuance/renewal. Corresponds to --key-file.

domains[].ca_file.description: Path to copy the intermediate CA certificate after issuance/renewal. Corresponds to --ca-file.

domains[].fullchain_file.description: Path to copy the fullchain certificate after issuance/renewal. Corresponds to --fullchain-file.

domains[].reloadcmd.description: Command to reload the target server after cert deployment. Corresponds to --reloadcmd.

domains[].preferred_chain.description: Preferred CA certificate chain issuer CN. Corresponds to --preferred-chain.

domains[].days.description: Days before expiration to trigger renewal. Corresponds to --days.

domains[].staging.description: Use ACME staging server. Corresponds to --staging.

domains[].force.description: Force cert renewal or override sudo restrictions. Corresponds to --force.

domains[].account_key.description: Path to account private key. Corresponds to --accountkey.

domains[].eab_kid.description: Key Identifier for External Account Binding. Corresponds to --eab-kid.

domains[].eab_hmac_key.description: HMAC key for External Account Binding. Corresponds to --eab-hmac-key.

domains[].httpport.description: Standalone HTTP server port (e.g., if behind proxy). Corresponds to --httpport.

domains[].tlsport.description: Standalone TLS server port (e.g., if behind proxy). Corresponds to --tlsport.

domains[].local_address.description: Standalone server listening IP address. Corresponds to --local-address.

domains[].listen_v4.description: Force standalone server to listen on IPv4 only. Corresponds to --listen-v4.

domains[].listen_v6.description: Force standalone server to listen on IPv6 only. Corresponds to --listen-v6.

domains[].no_cron.description: Skip installing automatic renewal cron job. Corresponds to --no-cron.

domains[].no_profile.description: Skip installing shell aliases. Corresponds to --no-profile.

domains[].auto_upgrade.description: Automatically upgrade acme.sh on --upgrade. Corresponds to --auto-upgrade.

domains[].use_wget.description: Force use of wget instead of curl. Corresponds to --use-wget.

domains[].insecure.description: Skip TLS verification for API calls. Corresponds to --insecure.

domains[].ca_bundle.description: Path to CA certificate bundle. Corresponds to --ca-bundle.

domains[].ca_path.description: Directory with CA certificates in PEM format. Corresponds to --ca-path.

domains[].openssl_bin.description: Path to custom openssl binary. Corresponds to --openssl-bin.

domains[].need_password.description: Whether to prompt for password for --to-pkcs12. If true, `password` must be set.

domains[].password.description: Password for PKCS#12 export. Only used when need_password is true.

domains[].ocsp.description: Request OCSP Must-Staple extension. Corresponds to --ocsp.

domains[].always_force_new_domain_key.description: Generate new domain key on every renewal. Corresponds to --always-force-new-domain-key.

domains[].output_insecure.description: Include sensitive data in debug output. Corresponds to --output-insecure.

domains[].force_color.description: Force colored output (e.g., for log capture). Corresponds to --force-color.

domains[].csr.description: Input CSR path for --sign-csr. Corresponds to --csr.

domains[].extended_key_usage.description: Extended Key Usage (EKU) OIDs. Only used when need_eku is true.

domains[].need_eku.description: Whether to include EKU extension. If true, `extended_key_usage` must be set.

domains[].challenge_alias.description: Domain alias for DNS alias mode. Corresponds to --challenge-alias.

domains[].domain_alias.description: Domain alias for DNS alias mode (parent domain). Corresponds to --domain-alias.

domains[].dnssleep.description: Seconds to wait for DNS propagation. Corresponds to --dnssleep.
